## Work experience (finance)
- **Sir Adamjee Institute**, Accountant & Client Coordinator, full-time, Apr 2025 to present. Prepares monthly student receivable reports, processes bad-debt adjustments, prepares audit documentation for external auditors, runs monthly payroll (salary calculation, statutory deductions, disbursement), and prepares daily cash-flow statements and bank reconciliations.
- **Telemart.pk**, Finance & Reporting Assistant, part-time, Aug 2025 to Aug 2026. Reduced unresolved receipt balances by 80% through ledger investigation, cleaned receivable ledgers, designed and deployed a Power BI sales dashboard with DAX time intelligence and month-over-month comparisons for senior management, and formulated an inventory return policy to improve the working-capital cycle.
- **Virtuo AR**, Financial Analyst & Excel Modeler, freelance/project-based, Sep 2023 to Jul 2024. Built a fully linked 3-statement financial model for a virtual try-on startup, a depreciation schedule (SLM and reducing balance), prospect financial statements with scenario analysis, an Excel KPI dashboard and invoice templates.
- **Tech Empire Pvt. Ltd**, Operations, Finance & Business Support Executive, full-time, Feb 2021 to Aug 2023. Managed a MySQL customer database, bookkeeping, invoicing and expense tracking, and CRM data on Monday.com.

## Finance projects
- **Virtuo AR 5-year financial model**: 3-statement model for a virtual try-on and 3D clothing startup. Projects PKR 245.5M cumulative revenue and PKR 79.2M net income, NPV PKR 71.1M, IRR 88.3% against a 25% WACC, breakeven in 2026, 2-year payback, 21.3x MOIC. Page: https://mr-avedia.github.io/Abdul-Qadir/virtuo-ar-model.html
- **NovaMart sales analytics dashboard**: executive dashboard for an e-commerce store showing PKR 97M total revenue across 12,814 orders with a 6.8% return rate; daily net revenue, top products by gross profit, sales by channel and category, monthly ad spend vs sales (Q1 2026). Page: https://mr-avedia.github.io/Abdul-Qadir/ecommerce-dashboard.html
